_comment: Things that must be true in BOTH MMC repositories at once.
MMC Build is two Next.js deployments from two repositories — the application
(app.mmcbuild.com.au) and the marketing site (www.mmcbuild.com.au). Almost every
silent failure this project has had came from that split: a change made in one
- 8 Aug: a feature flag switched eight surfaces and not the ninth.
- 8 Aug: Vercel Analytics was toggled on for both projects, and the marketing
repo had no analytics component at all — toggle on, dashboard agreeing, and
the site with nothing to send.
- Earlier: the two pricing pages drifted apart before anyone noticed.
None were carelessness. In each case a setting and the code it depends on lived
in different places, and only one was visible from where the person stood.

siblings.name: MMC application ↔ marketing site
_repos_comment: Paths are relative to the directory the audit is run from. Locally that is
the parent of both clones (--root ~/PycharmProjects). In CI both repos must
be checked out side by side, or the file/dependency half SKIPS with a
warning and only the live checks run — which the audit says out loud rather
_identicalFiles_comment: purchase-cta.ts is byte-identical BY DESIGN — it is what keeps the two sites
from selling and waitlisting at the same time. That was verified by hand with
`diff` when it was written (PR #149/#3), which works exactly once.
_sharedDependencies_comment: @vercel/analytics is the 8 August incident precisely: present in the app,
absent from marketing, analytics toggled on for both. Silent if NEITHER has
a package — that is a choice, not a drift.
_parityPaths_comment: The analytics beacon answered 200 on the app and 404 on the marketing site
for a day and nothing said so. This is the assertion that would have.
